name: com.voyagier/cli
title: Voyagier
description: Book real travel from your agent: flights, hotels and activities behind a price-gated checkout. Stdio proxy for the hosted Voyagier MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: VOYAGIER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Voyagier Personal Access Token (travel.voyagier.com → Settings → Personal Access Tokens). Access is by invitation — request at https://www.voyagier.com/agents.

environmentVariables.name: VOYAGIER_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Hosted Voyagier MCP endpoint the proxy forwards to. Defaults to https://mcp.voyagier.com/api/mcp; override only for non-production environments.
